findings.summary: Luna's claimed complete 21-product Toast catalog omitted at least Fried Tomato, Rillettes Trio, Market Soup, Duck, Lamb, Pommes Frites, and Baguette & Butter visible on the independently reopened catalog.
Luna did not enumerate active official Desserts and Petit Gourmand pages, home-linked beverage/event surfaces, or the observed Toast brunch state.

Official pages explicitly state ingredients are incomplete and menus may vary. Toast allergy request controls do not provide contains, negative, may-contain, or shared-equipment disclosure. No complete restaurant-issued allergen source was found.
The three Luna PDF sources lack reproducibility anchors and could not be independently reopened; they cannot support current menu, extraction, or allergen conclusions.

verifier.summary: Identity is verified, but Luna's catalog completeness is disproved. The independently reopened official and linked sources show additional active surfaces, at least seven omitted Toast products, and changing Toast service/catalog states. Restaurant-issued pages expressly disallow complete ingredient inference. Linked-vendor named ingredients support only narrow positives; no negative, complete-array, may-contain, or cross-contact conclusion is supported.
